advancement.kultivator.tempat.tema_iblis: Win a fight of the Hunting Hour.
Claim the bounty of a demonic fugitive at the Hunters' Post.
Reach Dread 80 in a Demon City.
Own the Dusk Blood Book of floor nine.
Fulfil a contract of the Contract Den.
Finish The Broken Chain on the road of Blood.
Win the Blood Tournament during a blood eclipse.
Pay the toll at the Demon City's Skull Gate.
Defeat Xue Yao, Lord of the Dusk Blood.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.tema_iblis_afu_k: That brat from the pens tried to run again. The Butcher caught her at the east wall. The fourth time.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.tema_iblis_akhir: Xue Yao has a new guest at her table. %s, people say. The righteous sects' gates are shut to that name.
The pens are shut, the chains hung on the Warning Field. Tu Gang rules the city, and everyone speaks the name of %s.
Morning came to the Demon City. Ye Wuhen rules, and they say %s brought the dawn.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.tema_iblis_anak_: Some stranger gave the slum children bread money. In this city! Maybe they're ill.
The enforcers drove the slum children from the common kitchen. A stranger reported them.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.tema_iblis_buron: %1$s, a fugitive of the Demon City, died by the hand of %2$s. The Hunters' Post paid the bounty.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.tema_iblis_kitab: The Dusk Blood Book left floor nine! Mo Wen says its owner is %s. The righteous sects must have heard by now.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.tema_iblis_laga_: Twelve bouts tonight. Night Crow against Iron Hand in the seventh. Place your bets before the gong.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.tema_iblis_lao_p: Lao Kuang retired! The old gladiator walked out of the gate with a sack of yam seedlings. Tu Gang counted the ransom twice.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.tema_iblis_lao_t: Lao Kuang's last bout, against %s. The whole crowd stood. His sword is on the Warning Field now.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.tema_iblis_lelan: Tonight the Black Auction Hall's red curtain parts. Bring money, and don't ask where the goods came from.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.tema_iblis_minya: Six barrels of Shadow Oil broke in the Contract Den's store. Bai She is smiling, which means someone will die. They say %s did it.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.tema_iblis_padam: They say someone tried to break this city's chain. They say they were too late. Xue Yao is still smiling.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.tema_iblis_pesta: A blood eclipse! Red lanterns at every door, the Blood Tournament in the arena, and floor nine of the tower open. Don't go out alone.
The moon is bleeding. This city does not sleep tonight.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.tema_iblis_ranta: Strange news from the Demon City: its chain is broken, and %s was in the middle of it all.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.tema_iblis_serbu: The gate gong rang three times. The enforcers sharpen their cleavers before the jaws.
The siege broke on the skull's jaws again. The gate toll is up by half these three days, to pay for the corpses.
The Skull Gate fell yesterday. The pens were emptied and the brokers are hiding. The market opens the day after tomorrow.
White robes on the horizon! A coalition of righteous sects besieges the Skull Gate. Harvest season again.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.tema_iblis_tawan: %1$s came home from the Demon City! They say %2$s ransomed them and escorted them all the way here.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.tema_iblis_topen: The Faceless Mask came back to the Market of a Thousand Shadows, and Bai She refused to wear it. Who took it back from the hunters: %s.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.tema_iblis_turna: %s won the Blood Tournament. Xue Yao herself applauded from the Lord's Box.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.tema_iblis_umum_: Never count money in the street after the soul lanterns are lit. In this city the clink of coins is louder than a scream.
The gate toll is paid once a day. Whoever pays twice isn't generous; the enforcers have just marked them as a fool.
The Poison Cup Tavern has twelve tables. The seventh is never taken. The owner says it's for the guest who hasn't died yet.
The tea at the Smoke Teahouse is brewed with slum well water. It's bitter, but at least you know the poison isn't in the tea.
The Contract Wall in the Assassins' Den never lists a citizen. Not out of mercy. Dead citizens pay no tribute.
The gladiators polish their blades with bone oil before the night bouts. The smell clings to the Blood Arena until morning.
Blind Mo Wen knows visitors by their steps. He says a liar's step is always half a beat too quick.
The shadow wolves in the gate kennel eat once a day, at the dusk gong. If they howl before the gong, there's an intruder.
The Black Auction Hall takes no spoken bids. Raise your finger, and don't sneeze; someone once bought an empty chest for a thousand Nilai Batu with a sneeze.
The slum children know every gap in the east wall. Pay them a piece of bread and they'll show you a way the enforcers don't guard.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.tema_iblis_warga: %1$s of %2$s has not come home for three nights. Someone saw men in iron masks on the road.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.tema_iblis_xue_k: Xue Yao knelt! The Lord of the Dusk Blood left her palace after %s beat her. Who will sit on that throne?
kultivator.cerita.kabar.tema_iblis_ye_hi: Ye Wuhen has not been seen since the palace banquet. His house is empty. Nobody dares ask.
kultivator.cerita.quest.tema_iblis_anak_: In the slum alleys the children now whistle whenever you pass: a sign that the road ahead is safe.
The enforcers drove the children from the common kitchen. They remember your face, but not kindly.
Help the children, or report them to the enforcers.
The Demon City's slum children steal bread from the common kitchen. You caught them at it.
kultivator.cerita.quest.tema_iblis_gladi: Lao Kuang walked out of the gate with a stick and a sack of seedlings. Tu Gang didn't look, but he counted your money twice.
Lao Kuang's sword now hangs on the Warning Field, among the challengers he once beat.
Give Lao Kuang his last bout in a duel, or buy his freedom from Tu Gang (120 NB).
Lao Kuang has fought forty years in the Blood Arena. He wants an honourable death, or to go home to his mother's yam garden.
kultivator.cerita.quest.tema_iblis_kitab: Your name is written in the guest book of the Tower of Forbidden Books. The upper floors greet you as if you were more feared than you are.
Gather three Lost Scripture Pages (sold in the capital and at auctions).
Blind Mo Wen wants three lost scripture pages. In return, the tower's upper shelves will know you.
Hand the three pages to Mo Wen on the tower's first floor.
kultivator.cerita.quest.tema_iblis_ranta: A guest at the blood table.
The chain is broken.
The first dawn.
Escort A-Fu out of the Skull Gate to her village, or any safe village.
Xue Yao still rules, and you sit beside her as Blood Guest. The gate and floor nine are open to you; the righteous sects' gates are closed.
Tu Gang now rules the Demon City. The Captive Pens are closed for good and the Hunters' Post became a garrison. On the Warning Field someone hung up a broken chain.
Ye Wuhen rules the city. Daytime is now safe on every street, and the pens became the House of Ransom. The citizens still squint at the sun.
The chance passed. Xue Yao still rules, and the taverns tell of a siege that broke on the skull's jaws.
Enter the Blood Palace and face Xue Yao, Lord of the Dusk Blood.
Attend Xue Yao's banquet in the Blood Palace. She has prepared one test of loyalty.
Look at the Captive Pens in the city's north-east and talk to the child who keeps trying to escape.
Madam Bai She wants a word about Shadow Oil. Its store is at the Contract Den: buy a share, or break all six barrels.
The Broken Chain
Time ran out.
Hear Ye Wuhen's warning on the Warning Field, by the Skull Gate.
Han Qingshuang at the Hunters' Post seeks the Map of the Secret Gate. Answer Blind Mo Wen's riddle of three books in the tower.
Decide whose hand the map falls into: Han Qingshuang (Righteous), Ye Wuhen (Redemption) or Xue Yao (Blood).

Ye Wuhen, a demonic cultivator once stolen from a village, asks you to look at the Captive Pens. Behind them wait the Shadow Oil ring, a map drawn with fingernails, the righteous siege, and the Lord of the Dusk Blood.
The siege begins. Defend the Skull Gate and beat Han Qingshuang in a duel. She will not die; she will withdraw.
The siege begins. Defeat the six guards of the lever room in the toll house and pull the Skull Gate's lever.
The siege begins. Meet Ye Wuhen in the Old Tunnel and escort the captives beyond the wall.
Free A-Fu: ransom her at the Captive Pens, or win a Blood Ransom in Tu Gang's arena. Or leave her.
kultivator.cerita.quest.tema_iblis_topen: Find the hunter squad's camp outside the Skull Gate and seize the Faceless Mask.
The hunters went home to their sect, the mask a trophy.
Bai She paid you and let you keep the mask. In the Demon City an unknown face is a shield.
Bring the mask back to Madam Bai She.
A righteous hunter squad stole a mask from Madam Bai She's stall during the siege. Take it back.
kultivator.cerita.tema_iblis_afu_mohon.j: Really? You promise? Tu Gang is at the arena. The pen jailer can take a ransom too. Hurry, okay... before they sell me.
kultivator.cerita.tema_iblis_afu_mohon.m: Hey! You're not from here, are you? Your clothes don't smell of blood. Please... I want to go home to my village. Mother must still be waiting for me under the walnut tree.
I'll find a way to get you out.
kultivator.cerita.tema_iblis_afu_mohon.n: A-Fu! I've escaped three times. Caught three times by the Butcher. He says if someone pays for me, or fights in the arena for me, my door can open. But who would?
...It's alright. I'm used to it. I'll run away on my own again. The fourth time will work, surely.
A Blood Ransom? You're mad... but thank you! Talk to Tu Gang, or choose Blood Ransom on the pens' list.
You came back! Did you talk to the jailer? Or the Butcher?
I'll fight for you in the arena.
kultivator.cerita.tema_iblis_anak_liar.b: You... give us money? In this city? Thank you! I'll remember your face!
kultivator.cerita.tema_iblis_anak_liar.m: Don't tell anyone! It's only three loaves... the common kitchen won't miss them. My little brother hasn't eaten in two days.
Thieves get reported to the enforcers.
kultivator.cerita.tema_iblis_baishe_miny: From the bones beneath this city, darling. Three thousand years of blood, pressed out slowly. The store is at the Contract Den; Hong Pao carries it out. You may have seen his red robe.
A wise choice. Welcome to the family, darling. Don't mind the talk of the righteous sects; they always complain.

Oh, the guest who freed that little mouse. I like people brave enough to spend money on useless things. Sit. Have you ever smelled Shadow Oil? One drop and a lantern burns seven nights without smoke. The harbours and the canal cities adore it... and the righteous sects loathe it.
Where does the oil come from?
Of course. The store is guarded, but its door is never locked. Who would dare steal from Bai She?
A share: %s, paid over five days. All you need to do is... see nothing.
kultivator.cerita.tema_iblis_baishe_sapa: The family price, of course. And a little free advice: Xue Yao's favourite guest before you sat in that same chair for nine years. Then one night he did not come to the banquet. Enjoy your chair, darling.
What do you desire, darling? Here, nothing is without a price.
How is the market since Tu Gang rules?
Did Ye Wuhen change the market?
Any special price for the Blood Guest?
The Market of a Thousand Shadows now opens by day. By day! My shadows shrink, my customers squint, and I've had to sell parasols. But profit is profit. Bai She has never lost to the sun.
The Butcher raised stall rents and banned chains in the market. Ironic, isn't it? Now the best-selling goods are locks. Everyone wants to lock something away, darling, and I sell the locks.
As it happens, yes. A righteous squad stole a Faceless Mask from my mask stall during the last siege. It's useless to them; they took it to insult me. Take it back, and I'll pay you properly.
kultivator.cerita.tema_iblis_baishe_tope: You brought it? Ah... it still smells of sect incense. Disgusting. Keep the mask; I won't wear something a hunter's hand has touched. Here is your fee.
kultivator.cerita.tema_iblis_cegat.mulai: In the name of the righteous path, your head is forfeit! ...Unless you would atone. A penance fine of %s, and you may go with your head attached.
kultivator.cerita.tema_iblis_cegat.tobat: Penance accepted. Don't let your name appear on our board again.
kultivator.cerita.tema_iblis_gladiator_s: See these scars? Each one a win. The one on my back... don't ask.
kultivator.cerita.tema_iblis_han_peta.ca: Mo Wen is blind, but he sees through books. Answer his riddle. And give that map to no one but me.
kultivator.cerita.tema_iblis_han_peta.ke: Because behind that wall there are pens, and in those pens are village folk who never chose the demonic path. I do not trust you. But I have no other choice.
kultivator.cerita.tema_iblis_han_peta.mu: You come from that city. Its blood incense still clings to you. I am Han Qingshuang, core disciple of %s. Listen: our sieges always break at the Skull Gate. If there were another way inside... they say Blind Mo Wen keeps the Map of the Secret Gate on the fourth floor of his tower.
kultivator.cerita.tema_iblis_han_sapa.ge: Every time I hold a sword. You won cleanly, and that hurts the most. I hold no grudge. But your name is written in this Post's book now, and one day a disciple younger than me will read it.
kultivator.cerita.tema_iblis_han_sapa.ko: A Head Contract from the black auction... A hundred and fifty Nilai Batu, and I won't ask how you got it.
kultivator.cerita.tema_iblis_han_sapa.ma: In the name of seven sects. The elders want to call it heaven's victory; I call it unfinished work. That city does not change overnight just because its chain broke. But the pens are empty, and that is enough for this year.
kultivator.cerita.tema_iblis_han_sapa.mu: The Hunters' Post. If you came for bounties, the board is there. If you came from that city with ill intent, my sword is here.
The Hunters' Post is a garrison now?
Are you angry I gave the map to Ye Wuhen?
Do you still remember the duel at the gate?
kultivator.cerita.tema_iblis_han_sapa.pe: Angry? I wanted my sword at Xue Yao's throat, and you gave me a demon who led the captives out without a single death. It keeps me thinking too long at night. Go. The bounty board is still open to you.
kultivator.cerita.tema_iblis_han_serbu.d: So that's your answer. Very well. Blade against blade. If I lose, I withdraw. If you lose... you go home in chains.
kultivator.cerita.tema_iblis_han_serbu.l: Good. Hold the left. Don't let the enforcers reach the archers.
kultivator.cerita.tema_iblis_han_serbu.m: The next wave is coming. Whose side are you on, you from the demon city?
Face me in a duel, Han Qingshuang.
kultivator.cerita.tema_iblis_hongpao.asi: I sell nothing. I only carry. If you carry nothing, leave.
kultivator.cerita.tema_iblis_hongpao.ken: You. I remember your face, from the docks and the canals. You keep following my oil's trail. The store is behind me, if that's what you're after. Six barrels. Don't say I told you.
kultivator.cerita.tema_iblis_hongpao.mul: You're Hong Pao? Bai She's courier?
You're Hong Pao? Bai She's courier?
My axe is dull again. Too many bones in last night's bouts.
kultivator.cerita.tema_iblis_lao_pilih.d: Ha... ha! Good. Don't hold back. Holding back would be an insult.
kultivator.cerita.tema_iblis_lao_pilih.m: A last bout. I'll be your foe.
kultivator.cerita.tema_iblis_lao_pilih.p: The yam garden... Mother must be long gone, but the garden may still be there. Thank you, kid. Lao Kuang will plant again.
kultivator.cerita.tema_iblis_lao_sapa.in: One of two. To die with a sword in hand, against someone worthy. Or go home to my mother's yam garden, if someone would buy my freedom from the Butcher. Choose for me, for I am too tired to choose.
kultivator.cerita.tema_iblis_lao_sapa.mu: Forty years in that pit. Four hundred bouts. My knees creak like the pen doors. Tu Gang says I still make money, so I'm not allowed to stop. Do you know what an old gladiator wants, kid?
kultivator.cerita.tema_iblis_makelar_sap: Psst. Poisons, blood pills, lair maps... here nothing is without a price. Just have a look.
kultivator.cerita.tema_iblis_mowen_kitab: Three pages. I can smell that library's ink, and the dust of a dead king. Thank you. Your name is now written in the tower's guest book.
The capital's Great Library keeps pages of lost scriptures. Bring me three pages, and the upper shelves will know you sooner than their fear would.
It knows your step before you reach the stairs. Careful: a book that knows its reader also knows what it most wants to eat from you. I gave it my eyes. Don't give it anything dearer.
This book devours something of whoever reads it. Will you still open it?
This city's chain is broken. What do your books say?
Does floor nine know me now?

Books don't care who rules. They are only hungry. But the shelf on floor three stopped whispering since that night. Perhaps they are waiting, like me, to learn what kind of city grows from the same bones.
Hope. Yes. This map was drawn by a captive a hundred years ago, with his fingernails, on the tunnel wall. Take it. Whoever's hand it falls into, that is this city tomorrow.
The second book: 'The more you take from me, the bigger I grow. Every captive who escapes leaves me in the wall of the pen.'
Your steps smell of gates. You seek a map that was never drawn. Floor four keeps three books; answer all three and the map is yours. Miss even one, and the books fall asleep for you again.
The book closes itself. Come back later, when it has forgotten your face.
The first book: 'I have cities without houses, rivers without water and mountains without stone. What am I?'
The third book: 'No enforcer can see me, no chain can touch me, and I open every gate. Everyone who escapes this place carries me away.'
kultivator.cerita.tema_iblis_pembunuh_sa: The contract wall is behind me. Only beasts, rival gangs, bandits and righteous dogs. We don't kill citizens. Bad for business.
kultivator.cerita.tema_iblis_pemburu_sap: The righteous sects' Hunters' Post. Leader Han checks every report herself.
kultivator.cerita.tema_iblis_penegak_dit: Feared One. Please pass. No toll for you.
kultivator.cerita.tema_iblis_pilih_han.m: That... is the map? A secret gate under the eastern wall. Give it to me, and the next siege won't stop at the skull's jaws.
kultivator.cerita.tema_iblis_pilih_han.s: I misjudged you. When the siege begins, open the gate from inside: the lever is in the toll house. I'll be waiting outside.
kultivator.cerita.tema_iblis_pilih_xue.m: You carry something that should not exist. A map of a gate even I did not know of. Interesting. What do you want?
I report this to you, my Lord.
kultivator.cerita.tema_iblis_pilih_xue.s: Loyalty. The rarest ware in my city. When the righteous come again, stand at my gate. And beat that core disciple in front of everyone.
kultivator.cerita.tema_iblis_pilih_ye.mu: Mo Wen's map? If Han gets it this city burns, and the captives burn with it. Give it to me. There's an Old Tunnel from the pens to beyond the wall. I can lead them out while every eye is on the gate.
kultivator.cerita.tema_iblis_pilih_ye.se: Thank you. When the siege begins, meet me at the inner end of the tunnel. We'll need someone who can fight.
kultivator.cerita.tema_iblis_tawanan_kan: Please... you're not a guard, are you? We only want to go home.
kultivator.cerita.tema_iblis_tugang_peng: That brat? Went home to her village with a sack of walnuts from the market. Walnuts! Ran from my pens four times and finally walked out the front door. If she comes back a swordswoman one day, I won't be surprised.
Because Leader Han asked, and because I'm the only man both sides fear. The enforcers fear my cleaver, the hunters fear my ledger. My ledger holds everyone's debts. That's the sharper weapon.

Lord? Me? Ha! I'm just a butcher who happens to still be standing. The pens are closed; the righteous hunters keep their post as a garrison. Market prices went up, but nothing is sold in chains anymore. My rules are the same: the strong win.
Why did you agree to rule?
kultivator.cerita.tema_iblis_tugang_sapa: Want to climb the Blood Ladder, or just watch other people bleed? Either way you pay.
Enter me in the Blood Tournament.
How is your pit since Ye Wuhen took the throne?
Did you see me defend the gate?
You held those skull jaws better than half my enforcers. But don't think I forget: Xue Yao's guest never climbs the Blood Ladder against cheap opponents. My pit has its own family price.
He banned bouts to the death. The crowd grumbled for a week, then came back. Turns out they come for the bets, not the blood. I lost two butchers and gained three peanut sellers. Hah!
kultivator.cerita.tema_iblis_tugang_serb: Ha! That's it. Take a place before the jaws. Whoever drops the most white robes drinks free at the Poison Cup for a week!
The righteous are at the gate! Meet them head on! Which side do you stand on, fighter?
kultivator.cerita.tema_iblis_tugang_tebu: Because in a lawless city my rules are the only ones that don't lie. The strong win, the winner gets paid. Fair.

Hah! You're the one the chatty brat keeps asking about. My rules are simple: pay the jailer, or bleed in my pit. Blood Ransom, the foe is one tier harder. If you drop, the kid stays caged and you get dragged out.
Why do you care about rules?
kultivator.cerita.tema_iblis_upeti.atura: One rule. In the Market of a Thousand Shadows and the Poison Cup Tavern no blood is spilled: that is the Market Pact. Outside, the strong are right. At night the streets have hunters of their own. The toll is paid once a day.
kultivator.cerita.tema_iblis_upeti.lewat: Go in. And remember: nobody will help you here.
kultivator.cerita.tema_iblis_upeti.mulai: Halt. Leave a tribute if you'd pass. It's cheaper than your life.
kultivator.cerita.tema_iblis_upeti_lemah: Small fry like you isn't even good bait. Go home, before someone takes you for a snack.
kultivator.cerita.tema_iblis_warga_malam: There's a bout at the Blood Arena tonight. I've bet on the Night Crow. He has never lost... twice.
Don't stare at me too long, stranger. In this city a stare counts as a challenge.
Sit, my guest. Dusk blood wine, three hundred years old. You held my gate and drove back that core disciple. One more test. Ye Wuhen sold my city's map to the rebels in the pens. Remove him, and you sit beside me forever.
No. I do not kill for you.
Cold and quick. I like you. Ye Wuhen will not be seen in my city again.
Hm. Refusing Xue Yao at her own table. Very well. Fight Ye Wuhen in the hall, not to the death. If you win, you prove yourself sharper than your loyalty. That is enough for me too.
kultivator.cerita.tema_iblis_xue_sapa.ko: Three thousand years ago the Blood Demon Lord fell on this ground. The righteous sects called it victory. They left his bones here, and we built a gate from his jaw. Our city stands on the defeat of those who thought they had won.
kultivator.cerita.tema_iblis_xue_sapa.mu: You stand before the Lord of the Dusk Blood uninvited. Speak, before I grow bored.
I want to hear about this city.
The Lord will not receive you yet (Dread 60 needed).
kultivator.cerita.tema_iblis_xue_tamu.mu: My Blood Guest. My gate opens for you without a toll, my market gives you the family price, and floor nine knows your name. The righteous sects shut their gates to you, of course. They never learned to value honesty.
kultivator.cerita.tema_iblis_xue_tantang: Outside, the righteous sects kill in heaven's name and call it justice. Here we kill for profit and call it trade. At least we are honest.
You opened my gate, or stole my pens. Now you stand before me with a drawn blade. How rare, a righteous one knocking at hell's gate of their own accord.
This city ends tonight, Xue Yao.
Why did you build all this?
Then let this blood pool decide who is honest.
kultivator.cerita.tema_iblis_ye_duel.mul: You refused her. I heard it from behind the curtain. Then we fight, but nobody dies tonight. Ready?
kultivator.cerita.tema_iblis_ye_peringat: The Pact Zone, the market and the taverns, is the only safe ground. Outside it, from seven at night until dawn, comes the Hunting Hour: they will bar your way and ask a road toll. Pay, or bleed. And never kill inside the market. The enforcers will hunt you like dogs.
If you still have a heart, go and look at the Captive Pens to the north-east. There's a child there who keeps trying to escape. She reminds me of myself. Just look. That is all I ask.
Because twenty years ago I was a stranger here too. They took me from my village when I was six. I grew up in those pens, then in the gladiators' room, then... I became one of them. Almost.

You just paid the toll, didn't you? I can tell by how you look at those posts. That is the Warning Field: broken weapons and cracked masks of everyone who ever challenged the Lord. Listen to me for a moment, %s, and maybe your weapon won't end up hanging here too.
Why would you care about a stranger?
kultivator.cerita.tema_iblis_ye_sapa.due: You refused to kill me at Xue Yao's table. In this city that is rarer than red jade. We stand on different sides, but I owe you one life. Don't spend that debt on something small.
kultivator.cerita.tema_iblis_ye_sapa.mul: Still alive? Good. In this city that is an achievement.
Tell me about the city's ruler.
How does it feel to rule this city?
Tu Gang rules now. You don't mind?
No grudge about the duel in the hall?
kultivator.cerita.tema_iblis_ye_sapa.pen: Heavy. Morning comes every day now, but the people here are not used to light yet. Those pens are the House of Ransom now. Sometimes I still hear chains at night.
kultivator.cerita.tema_iblis_ye_sapa.tu_: The Butcher? He rules the way he runs his pit: hard, fair, and always counting the money twice. I prefer that to Xue Yao's smile. Besides, I never wanted a throne. I only wanted to hear morning.
kultivator.cerita.tema_iblis_ye_sapa.xue: Xue Yao. Polite, calm, and she has killed more people than you could count. She says this city is the only honest place in the world: at least here nobody pretends to be pure.
kultivator.cerita.tema_iblis_ye_terowong: They're coming. I've loosened the rubble stones from inside; when the first wave hits the gate, the tunnel opens. You lead, I'll cover the rear. Don't stop until we see the sky.
kultivator.kota_tema.iblis.akhir.sub: The Demon City will never be the same.
kultivator.kota_tema.iblis.alasan.arena: a win in the Blood Arena
kultivator.kota_tema.iblis.alasan.bunuh_: killing a citizen inside the walls
kultivator.kota_tema.iblis.arena.diburu: The enforcers hunt you; the arena takes no fugitive of the city.
kultivator.kota_tema.iblis.arena.habis: Tu Gang refuses: %s bouts a day is enough for anyone.

kultivator.lore.kota_tema.iblis.1: This city stands on the battlefield where the righteous sects defeated the Blood Demon Lord three thousand years ago. The earth is still red a knee deep down, and the giant bones of the Skull Gate are said to be his.
kultivator.lore.kota_tema.iblis.2: There is no law but the Market Pact: inside the market and the taverns no blood is spilled; outside, the strong are right. The city's ruler takes a toll from every door, rents out the arena and keeps the Tower of Forbidden Books.
kultivator.lore.kota_tema.iblis.3: The righteous sects put bounties on its people's heads, and every few full moons a hunting host besieges its walls. The citizens call the sieges 'harvest season' and bet on how long the gate will hold.
kultivator.lore.kota_tema.iblis.sumber: Source: the Black-Corner Region of Battle Through the Heavens by Tian Can Tu Dou and its Black Mark City with the entry fee (Wuxiaworld translation, around chapters 383-387); common xianxia tropes of demonic-path cities, blood arenas and righteous bounty hunts. The layout, characters, prices and numbers are the game's design.
